note: Questions the MBA persona would plausibly ask, spread across the map. The last two are controls in areas the persona knows well; the profile should not make those answers simpler.

questions.q: Why does a spinning top stay upright instead of falling over?
Why is the sky blue but sunsets are red?
My analyst said the derivative of our cost function is zero at the optimum. What does that actually mean?
A data scientist told me two of our KPIs are 'linearly dependent' so one is redundant. What does linearly dependent mean?
What is a proof by contradiction, and why is it considered valid?
Our engineers say switching to an O(n log n) algorithm from an O(n^2) one will fix the slowdown. What do those notations mean and why would it help?
What is an unreliable narrator, and why would an author choose to use one?
Why did the Bretton Woods system collapse in the early 1970s?
Why does a monopolist produce less than a competitive market would, and who loses from that?
When inflation is high, what is the difference between using fiscal policy and monetary policy to fight it?
